title: Jokulsarlon Glacier Lagoon, Diamond Beach & Blue Ice Cave from Hornafjörður Airport Small Group Tour
shortTitle: Blue Ice Cave from Hornafjörður Airport
excerpt: Jokulsarlon Glacier Lagoon, Diamond Beach & Ice Cave from Hornafjörður Airport
description:
Start your day with a scenic drive from Höfn to Jökulsárlón. Be awed as the morning light illuminates the mountains and glaciers of this otherworldly landscape. Be amazed by the frozen enchantment of Europe's largest glacier lagoon on a full-day tour of the legendary Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon from Hofn. Marvel at a landscape comprising of crystal clear water and floating icebergs as you explore the area. Add some sparkles to your day at the Diamond Black Sand Beach. Explore some ice cave in the Vatnajökull National Park where the largest glacier in Europe lies. Bring your day to the perfect close with a scenic ride back to Hornafjörður Airport
• Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon, Diamond Beach and Ice Cave tour
• Highly rated and recommended by guests

title: Enchanted Eastfjords Elves, Puffins, Vok Baths from Seydisfjordur
shortTitle: Enchanted Eastfjords Elves, Puffins, Vok Baths
excerpt: Embark on an epic journey from Seyðisfjörður to Borgarfjörður Eystri, traversing wild mountain passes and uncovering the legendary secrets of East Iceland in a cozy small-group adventure.
description: Escape the crowded coach tours and discover the magic of East Iceland in comfort and style. This exclusive small-group shore excursion from Seyðisfjörður takes you across breathtaking mountain passes to Borgarfjörður Eystri, the legendary home of Iceland’s hidden people and one of the country’s best puffin colonies. Visit the Elf Queen’s fortress, enjoy optional refreshments at the charming Alfacafé, and unwind in the floating geothermal pools of Vök Baths. Travel in a luxury Mercedes Sprinter with onboard Wi-Fi, immersive multi-language audio guides, and guaranteed on-time return to your cruise ship.
The designated pick-up location for our tours from Seyðisfjörður harbor follows the below pick-up protocol:
If the cruise ship docks directly at the terminal, our guide/driver will wait inside the terminal building, near the main exit.
If the ship arrives by tender, the meeting point will be outside at the open dock area, where tenders disembark passengers from that specific Cruise.

itinerary.title: Capital of Elves, Iceland
itinerary.body:
Escape the crowded big-bus tours and experience East Iceland in comfort, style, and authenticity aboard a premium 19-seat Mercedes Sprinter.

This exclusive shore excursion takes you deep into the untouched landscapes of East Iceland, crossing dramatic mountain passes toward Borgarfjörður Eystri - Iceland’s legendary “Capital of the Elves.” Along the way, uncover stories of folklore, hidden people, and Viking heritage while surrounded by breathtaking fjords and rugged coastal scenery.

Get remarkably close to nesting puffins at one of Iceland’s most accessible puffin colonies, visit the legendary fortress of the Elf Queen, and enjoy free time at the charming Álfakaffi café, where guests may optionally purchase traditional Icelandic refreshments and homemade specialties.

The journey concludes with pure relaxation at the serene Vök Baths, where you can float in naturally warm geothermal pools set directly on the lake, immersed in the peaceful beauty of East Iceland.

With small-group exclusivity, immersive storytelling, premium transportation, and a guaranteed return to your cruise ship, this experience offers a far more intimate and luxurious alternative to standard coach excursions.

bring: Please bring warm and waterproof clothing.
Swimsuit and towel recommended for Vök Baths.
Puffin sightings are seasonal and generally best from late spring through summer.
This tour is specifically designed for cruise passengers and includes a guaranteed on-time return policy.
goodToKnow: Infants must not sit on laps
A minimum of 6 people is required for the tour to take place
